title: Identifying Intercostal Muscles
page_title: Intercostal Muscles - IGCSE Biology Revision Notes

blocks.name: Identifying intercostal muscles: Extended
blocks.definition: Identify in diagrams and images the internal and external intercostal muscles

blocks.md:
- Muscles are only able to pull on bones, not push on them
- This means that there must be two sets of intercostal muscles; one to pull the rib cage up and another set to pull it down
- One set of intercostal muscles is found on the outside of the ribcage (the **external** intercostal muscles)
- The other set is found on the inside of the ribcage (the **internal** intercostal muscles)

blocks.alt: Diagram of human thorax showing labelled lungs, bronchi, bronchioles, trachea, ribs, intercostal muscles (external on the outside and internal on the inside), pleural membranes, pleural fluid and diaphragm
blocks.caption: There are two sets of intercostal muscles: the external, on the outside of the ribcage, and the internal, on the inside of the ribcage
